name: The Isle of the Cursed Prophet
storyline: The Isle of the Cursed Prophet tells the dark tale of Oliver Taylor, who, after the death of his wife Madalin, devotes his life to finding a way to bring her back from the dead. Years of searching and studying ancient texts finally lead him to the Necronomicon – a book of dark powers said to hold the secret of reanimation. In the hope of saving his beloved, Oliver travels to the mysterious Isle of the Cursed Prophet, where on one fateful night he has a chance to open the gateway to the other side. The game immerses you in a moody, mystical atmosphere, with a vast map to explore, dangerous foes to overcome, and the constant question of what price Oliver must pay for his wish.
